_: The town shows the realm's state in its streets (town_life.gd _moods; docs/TUNING.md). The state is the bridge's (each city's atWar, famine, celebrating in /world, and the muster scene for a levy, read through works.gd states); this only says how it looks. on: the switch (--moods=off: the town dressed as before). A state's row: stalls_open (the share of market stalls still kept: the rest stand shut, no keeper, no buyers), rack (swords on the armoury rack when it starts), hammer (how fast the smiths swing, times their own pace), muster (men gathered in the square: men, rows, how far from the well toward the seen side in world units, and the share of them soldiers), leave (a levy: one man every [fewest, most] seconds shoulders his bundle and walks out along the road, until most have gone; kin: who stays at the square to see them off), feast (tables: long tables set in the square, seats a side; bunting: lines of pennants from a pole by the well out to poles round the square, height in metres, flags a line, sag in metres; colours: the house's, then these). A court ruling standing at the town (the bridge's rulings.js) is a state too, and the herald cries it in the square with listeners cheering or dismayed (works.json counts.listeners, weights): relief (Manor Lords' market approval: buyers [fewest, most] at each stall, goods heaped as in good times), justice (Stronghold's gallows and CK3's dread: an empty gallows at the square's seen edge, guards and a silent crowd, from_well out), grant (CK3's granted holding: the house's banners round the square, ring out, and a building site for it, site a Freeciv building name read as its kit, progress risen), build (Manor Lords' works: the ordered work's site with its builders).
_centre: Round the square's centrepiece (a fountain at a seat; towns.gd root meta centrepiece, its real footprint): how far past its basin's rim things stand (game units). mourners: the grief's kneelers; candles: their candles set down; bunting: the feast's tall pole; fire: the feast's bonfire (past its own heat too), moved off the heart to the seen side, its dancers and tables round it.
